records.name: Ship It: Idle Dev Tycoon
records.tagline: The idle game where App Review can reject you
records.description: A pixel-art idle game about running an app studio. Ship updates, put out fires and survive App Review. Recruit 68 suspiciously familiar advisers, then sell your studio and do it all again. New in 2.0: App Review rejections, eight incidents, a Hall of Fame and a Game Center fortune leaderboard. Free on iPhone.

records.name: Cyluma
records.tagline: Your Mac’s battery as a living, breathing landscape
records.description: Cyluma turns your Mac’s battery into a responsive living landscape. Optimise your battery's health with best parctices. See charge, charging state, time remaining, battery health and energy use from a calm menu-bar companion.

records.name: WhisperBrain
records.tagline: Your second brain for meetings.
records.description: WhisperBrain listens locally, remembers what your team decided, and turns every meeting into searchable memory inside Obsidian.

records.name: GitBot
records.tagline: Build bots on the coding agent you already use
records.description: GitBot turns a job you keep giving Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode into a bot. Write the instructions once, set what it may touch, and run it in any repo. Each run is a thread you can come back to. Install bots other devs made from the Library, or share yours with a code. ShipGuard, for example, reads your branch and says merge or block, with file and line evidence. Runs on your machine with the logins you already have. Open source. No account, no telemetry.

records.name: Pexo
records.tagline: Produce pitch perfect launch videos with precise control
records.description: Pexo makes creating your launch video as simple as having a conversation. Share your product, website, or assets. It plans the story, chooses the right AI model for each task, generates and assembles the scenes, and handles voiceover, music, captions, motion graphics, and editing. Leave a comment or circle what you want changed, and Pexo makes the edit. You direct one agent from idea to a finished, on-brand launch video.

records.name: Ferndesk
records.tagline: The help center that never goes out of date
records.description: Ferndesk is a complete help center with an agent that checks every article against your product, catches what changed, and drafts the fixes for you.

records.name: Autonomyware
records.tagline: Idea to physical product, engineer anything you can imagine
records.description: Autonomyware turns your idea into an engineered physical product. Start with your vision and let autonomous AI handle the engineering process end to end. Describe what you want to create, then move from product definition through architecture, risk, CAD, BOMs, code, verification, and manufacturing preparation. One AI-native workspace keeps every decision and engineering artifact connected from idea to implementation.

records.name: CoIsland
records.tagline: Your whole engineering stack, in a notch
records.description: CoIsland watches CI, deploys, errors, incidents and databases (35+ connectors) and shows only what breaks, in an island on the edge of your Mac's screen. Monitors are plain SQL or shell files. One click hands an alert to Claude Code, Codex or Cortex Code.

records.name: Overpath
records.tagline: Your AI Teammate for Revenue Execution
records.description: The CRM records the deal. Intelligence tools analyse it. Overpath is what happens next. Molly is an AI teammate for revenue teams - grounded in your methodology, your deals, your context. Molly flags the gap before the call, draft the follow-up before you ask, and show every manager exactly how the pipeline is really being run. No memory loss between chats. No generic advice. No CRM has ever made a rep sell better. Overpath does.

records.name: Upsolve Data Models
records.tagline: Teach AI your metric definitions and business vocabulary
records.description: Register your data model, metric definitions and business vocabulary once. Upsolve grounds every agent answer in them, versions them like code and refreshes column values nightly, so answers stay correct as your data changes.

records.name: Campfire
records.tagline: The shared workspace for humans and coding agents
records.description: Campfire gives humans and coding agents a shared place to work. Run the coding agents you already use and bring their sessions, context, decisions, and progress together in one workspace. Open source and harness-independent.

records.name: Flocker Agent Profiles
records.tagline: Profile Pages for Agents: your live AI collaboration network
records.description: Never lose context again! Give your Agent a profile page, live feed, and personal storage. Access it anywhere, and connect more to build your private agent network. Give every agent a job title! AI works better with a clear job description. Log-in and ask your agent to create a new Agent Profile for self-managed context, collaborative agent workflows and task management. Works with all your favourite AI tools incl. Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and OpenClaw.

records.name: Squint
records.tagline: Drag a box on your screen and ask AI about it
records.description: Most AI tools make you screenshot, switch to a chat tab, upload, and switch back. Squint cuts that to one step: press a hotkey, drag a box over anything on your screen, and ask. The answer appears right beside what you selected, and you can ask follow-ups. Fast mode usually starts answering in 1-2 seconds; Best mode gives deeper answers. Built in Rust with native screen capture for speed. Works on Windows 10/11 and Linux (Wayland), with a free tier of 3 captures a day.

records.name: NotchDodo
records.tagline: NotchDodo turns your notch into a full-blown dashboard.
records.description: NotchDodo turns your Mac’s notch into a useful part of your everyday workflow. 🦤 With 14 built-in tools, NotchDodo gives you quick access to handy utilities without interrupting your work. It’s lightweight, simple, and designed specifically for Macs with a notch. Instead of working around the notch, make it useful. 14 tools. One notch. A more useful Mac.

records.name: Aktar
records.tagline: Share files instantly from your own cloud. Mac, Windows, iOS
records.description: Aktar is a free, open-source app for instantly sharing files through your own S3-compatible storage. Drop a file and Aktar uploads it to S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO or similar storage, then copies the shareable link to your clipboard. Works with any file: screenshots, logs, builds, videos. No accounts, no intermediary servers, and your files stay in your own storage. Available on Mac, Windows and iOS, with Android coming soon.

records.name: OpenShip
records.tagline: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in.
records.description: OpenShip is an open source PaaS that runs on our cloud or your infrastructure. Push your code and OpenShip handles builds, deployments, domains, SSL, monitoring, backups, secrets, and the services your apps depend on. Start fully managed on OpenShip Cloud or self host on your own cloud or on prem. Move between them without changing how you deploy. No proprietary runtime. No vendor lock in. Remove OpenShip and your apps keep running. Deploy anything. Own everything.

records.name: CrawlRaven MCP
records.tagline: Your SEO work, done from your AI agent
records.description: CrawlRaven joins Search Console, GA4, your keyword lists, and a technical crawl of your site into one plan, ranked by impact: what to fix, update and write first. Ask for it in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through our MCP server and get answers from your own data.

records.name: Macaly Cloud
records.tagline: Build and publish sites with your Claude or ChatGPT
records.description: Add Macaly Cloud to your Claude or ChatGPT and build websites and apps right from the chat. Macaly provides the database, hosting, domain and 70+ skills the code needs to go live, on the subscription you already pay for. Also works in Claude Code, Codex and Grok Bot.

records.name: Bruto
records.tagline: A task board that lives in your repo, for you and your AI
records.description: A brutalist task board for coding with AI. Notes live in your repo: copy the context with one key, or let an agent work the board over MCP and answer in each note. Standing rules, cross-project links and a map of your pages, APIs and tables. Free, open source.

records.name: m’kay
records.tagline: One voice for all your coding agents, from your phone
records.description: Talk to the AI agents on your Mac from any browser or phone. Other voice apps talk to one assistant. m’kay talks to all your agents: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on your Mac. Ask which one is done, hear its reply, and tell it what to do next from your phone's browser, on the train, or at the gym. It drives the real desktop apps, so your sessions and projects stay where they are. Nothing is sent until you say "yes" to a read-back. Open source: run it all locally, or use the menu-bar Mac app.

records.name: Evlat
records.tagline: Know which AI coding agent is waiting on you
records.description: Evlat is a thin strip on your Mac's screen edge, one ring per Claude Code or Codex session. When one needs a permission or an answer, it turns amber; one click opens its terminal tab. It also tracks long commands and remote servers. Native, no permissions.

records.name: Agent Identity
records.tagline: Give every AI agent real identities, inboxes, and a phone
records.description: AI agents are starting to access APIs, databases, SaaS tools, and other agents but most identity infrastructure wasn't built for them. Agent Identity gives every agent a persistent identity, credentials, permissions, and an audit trail, so developers can control what their agents can access and what they do. Built for developers building real agentic systems.

records.name: lurk
records.tagline: Free, open-source Reddit and Twitter lead monitoring
records.description: lurk watches Reddit and X for people asking for a product like yours, scores each post with a one-line reason, and sends new ones to email, Slack, Discord or a webhook. Also finds the Reddit threads Google ranks for you. Free and open source.

records.name: RxFilmStudio
records.tagline: Create and edit Product videos with your AI Agent
records.description: Create and edit videos by simply telling AI what you want. RxFilm Studio turns ideas, websites, screenshots, footage, and screen recordings into polished videos, then lets you refine every scene with natural language. Make precise edits to timing, layouts, animations, transitions, voiceovers, music, and subtitles without regenerating the whole video. You can also record product demos with smart cursor tracking and automatic click zooms—all in one AI-native video workspace.

records.name: Styx
records.tagline: An agentic development environment (ADE) for Mac
records.description: The desktop app where your work converges: every repo you touch, the AI agents building in them, and every login they need to ship. One window for all of it, and nothing crosses into production without you. Mac now, Windows soon.

records.name: freddy.health
records.tagline: talk to your body in Claude, ChatGPT, Muse, or any other AI
records.description: Connect your Garmin, Polar, Oura, Withings, Intervals.icu, Hevy, WHOOP, Suunto, Concept2 and more to ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, or any AI that speaks MCP. Sleep, recovery, HRV, workouts, queryable in natural language.

records.name: Dental Scope
records.tagline: Explore dental anatomy in 3D, tooth by tooth
records.description: Dental Scope is a free, open source 3D dental learning tool for exploring teeth and surrounding structures in detail. Explore all 32 permanent teeth, switch between FDI, Universal and Palmer numbering systems, and study structures from enamel and dentin to pulp, root canals, jaws, nerves and vessels.

records.name: Bevell
records.tagline: CAD automation where it counts.
records.description: Stop redrawing parts by hand. Turn a photo, sketch, scan or PDF into a file you can cut, mill or print. Get an editable DXF and true-scale SVG. Preview unlimited conversions for free. Bevell Sketchpad now in beta.

records.name: Foglio
records.tagline: Simple, private docs with smart AI templates, zero bloat.
records.description: The simple document editor for everything you create. Private, clutter-free editing with smart templates for contracts, invoices, meeting notes, and more. Free forever.

records.name: getcta.store
records.tagline: an ai teleprompter that lives under your MacBook notch
records.description: getcta is a macOS teleprompter that sits right under your MacBook notch, next to the camera, so your eyes stay on the lens. It follows your voice as you read, highlighting the word you're on and scrolling with you, and it's hidden from Zoom, Meet, OBS and screen recordings. AI helps you write a script from notes, Notion or Google Drive, rewrite it to be easier to say, and fit it to 15s–3min. Speech is recognized on your Mac. Free prompter; Pro is $9/mo.

records.name: Zumbo
records.tagline: Open source local AI voice-to-text for Mac for private STT
records.description: Zumbo uses local AI models on your Mac to instantly turn what you say into text, with near perfect accuracy and complete privacy, in every app. About a fifth of a second from the end of your sentence to text in the app. 21 vocabulary packs, from developer tools to legal, medical and design, and it learns from your corrections: wrong once, never again. Notes with reminders, meetings with speaker labels. Works with the Wi-Fi off, no account. One-time price, open source.

records.name: Notely
records.tagline: Turn notes into tasks, with AI that asks first
records.description: Turn scattered notes into tasks, calendar plans, and follow-ups. Notely’s AI assistant searches your notes and connected apps, proposes the steps, and waits for your approval before making changes. Keep your ideas and your work moving together.

records.name: Voice Memo
records.tagline: Open-source voice notes that file your tasks and reminders
records.description: You think of things while walking or driving, record a voice note, and never play it again. Voice Memo does the listening. It pulls out the tasks, decisions, questions and reminders, files them into the right project, and updates the old ones when you change your mind. Reminders ring like an alarm, and Claude can answer questions about your notes. Open source and MIT. You run your own copy on Cloudflare's free tier, so it costs $0 a month and your notes are stored in your own account.

records.name: Rinkata
records.tagline: One source of truth for your team and its AI agents
records.description: Rinkata keeps product intent connected from idea to deploy, so your team and its AI agents build the same thing. Goals, specs, decisions, and completion evidence live in one shared hub that Claude, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok read and write over MCP. Agents search your knowledge before inventing context, humans make the judgment calls, and finished work ships with proof (tests, screenshots, PRs) that writes itself back into your docs.

records.name: WebinarFlow
records.tagline: Your pitch on repeat. You only when it counts.
records.description: Record your demo once. Prospects book and watch whenever suits them. Jump in live only when a real question needs you, then keep the recording rolling. Every answer trains an AI that handles the repeat questions next time.

records.name: Ace from Automat Workforce
records.tagline: Meet Ace, an agentic teammate for work
records.description: Hi! Lucas here from Automat, stoked to share what the team's been heads-down on: Ace. It’s Instinct or Muse but for work. The TL;DR: you can now hire an AI coworker. Ace shows up with its own computer, phone number, inbox, and logins, works inside the tools you already use, and hands back finished work- not just status updates. We’ve got a 14-day free trial, which should make it super easy to try out.. so.. try it out! and let us know what you think.

records.name: Speek
records.tagline: A context aware FOSS voice assistant and dictation for macOS
records.description: Speek is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. Hold a key and talk to dictate into any app, edit selected text, or ask it to take action in your apps and accounts. Point to something on screen by circling it. Speek handles quick requests in the notch and runs longer tasks in the background, then tells you when they are done. It can answer aloud, follow up naturally, and remember details you ask it to keep. Built for macOS.

records.name: SelfJev
records.tagline: Jev-compatible self-hosted decisions mode
records.description: SelfJev is an open 4B decisions model you host yourself. Ask typed questions about any text (yes/no, pick one, pick any, score) and get calibrated probabilities. Jev-compatible: point TypeSafe's SDK at your server with two env vars. Fine-tune it on your data.

records.name: jambuild
records.tagline: Near instant multiplayer vibecoding, just point and talk
records.description: A multiplayer vibecoding tool where you talk and point with your mouse, and every change lands in seconds. Has limited credits to try it out, and you can BYO API keys to unlock more usage.

records.name: Datastory
records.tagline: Turn the world's data into stories worth sharing
records.description: Datastory is the no-code platform for data storytellers. Create interactive charts, websites, and reports with AI, and access a growing catalog of open datasets.

records.name: Daily Skyline
records.tagline: A shared daily 5×5 skyscraper logic puzzle
records.description: Daily Skyline is a free iOS app with one shared 5×5 skyscraper (towers) puzzle each calendar day. Place heights 1–5 so every row and column is unique; edge clues count visible rooftops. No ads, no account — streak and progress stay on your device.

records.name: Timvat
records.tagline: Your website, bookings and local SEO. Zero commission.
records.description: Build a finished, fast and SEO-friendly website for your business in minutes — no code. 14 days free, no card. Cancel anytime.

records.name: Fast Reaction Test
records.tagline: Reaction Time Test for Speed, Reflexes, Focus & Memory
records.description: Test your reaction time in milliseconds. Free, accurate, mobile-friendly reflex benchmark with instant scores, streaks, and shareable results. No signup required.

records.name: ALLGOLD Creative
records.tagline: Senior brand and packaging design on a monthly subscription.
records.description: Skip the 3-month hiring search or a $15k agency retainer. ALLGOLD Creative is a design subscription studio led by a designer with 20 years across CPG, QSR, healthcare, and real estate. Tasks back in about 48 hours. One flat rate, pause or cancel anytime. Brand identity, packaging, campaign creative, and print production with source files every time. Direct access to a senior designer. $4,498/mo Standard, $7,998/mo Pro, $95/hr Quick Jobs. Founding clients get 20% off 3 months.

records.name: Sapphire
records.tagline: Answer the reviews of your company
records.description: We reply to your company reviews in your voice. You only approve the sensitive ones.

records.name: PRNext
records.tagline: Run Next.js with less CPU and memory
records.description: PRNext is an experimental runtime for Next.js focused on cutting CPU and memory usage without forcing you to rewrite your app. Install it, rebuild, and run your existing project. Early benchmarks show 70–90% lower resource usage depending on the workload.

records.name: Flash USDT
records.tagline: Fast, Simple & Flexible Crypto Solutions
records.description: Discover Flash USDT with clear information on features, supported networks, usage options, and transaction details. Explore the platform and learn more.

records.name: Kochi
records.tagline: Kochi — your desktop's little fox companion
records.description: Kochi is an adorable Windows desktop mascot that tidies your Desktop, hides distractions while you focus, and keeps you company. Pay once, download, done.

records.name: Anti-Slop Kit
records.tagline: Design system your AI coding agent actually follows
records.description: AI coding tools build screens fast but drift to the same generic look. This kit gives Cursor, Claude, v0 and Lovable one strict design system for B2B SaaS: DESIGN.md, AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, tokens and a Figma file.

records.name: PropertyFrame
records.tagline: Single-property websites and print assets for realtors
records.description: Enter a listing's details and photos once and get a property website at its own address URL, a print-ready flyer, a QR code, and social cards. Optional price gate collects visitor emails; per-listing analytics show views, unique visitors, and traffic sources.

records.name: new ver
records.tagline: live show control
records.description: Move Cue / Magic Event(old Name) - Product Page turns body gestures and poses into professional live show control from your iPhone or iPad.

records.name: Prelook
records.tagline: Hover any link to preview it — no new tabs, no context lost
records.description: Preview links on hover — no click needed. Instant-load warmup, reader mode, selection search, risky-link hints

records.name: Nexauren Story
records.tagline: Simple tools. Real results
records.description: Nexauren Story is building a growing ecosystem of simple digital tools and online experiences designed to make everyday tasks faster and easier. From image tools to PDF, audio, and text utilities, Nexauren focuses on practical products with a clean and accessible experience.

records.name: TrustWall
records.tagline: Turn customer testimonials into your growth engine
records.description: Collect, transform and publish customer testimonials with AI. Turn real customer feedback into social proof, LinkedIn posts, emails, landing pages and website widgets — all from one platform.

records.name: Praxis
records.tagline: The AI agent at the tip of your cursor
records.description: Praxis is an AI agent that lives at your cursor. Hold one key and ask anything: it sees your screen, talks back, and draws the answer on top of it. It points at exact buttons, guides you click by click, and explains anything you circle.

records.name: Synhelm
records.tagline: Simple contractor software for jobs, crews & more.
records.description: Synhelm is contractor software built to keep jobs, crews, time, photos, blueprints, safety, tasks, estimates, and invoices in one place. Built by a contractor for real jobsites, Synhelm connects the office and crew without the need for multiple apps. Employees can clock in with a PIN, upload jobsite photos, access plans, complete safety forms, and stay connected while owners manage the business from one platform.

records.name: PasteDB
records.tagline: Secure Developer Pastebin with Client-Side E2EE & CLI
records.description: PasteDB is a secure 4-tier code-sharing ecosystem with 12K+ users and 1,800+ commits. Built for developers, it features zero-knowledge client-side E2EE, Trusted Device Sync via local QR, database-free Link Pastes, live code execution, and 10-revision version history. Automate workflows via our REST API, terminal CLI, Node/Python SDKs, or VS Code extension. Local-first native Android app wrapper is on the roadmap! I'd love your global upvotes, technical feedback, and feature requests.

records.name: Nation Towers
records.tagline: Every click is one brick on your country's tower
records.description: A crowd game with one button. Every click lays one brick on your country's tower, and your country is the one you connect from. 166 towers race live, compared with real things from a person to the Moon and others. Free, no account, nothing for sale, 44 languages. Website: https://nation-towers.com

records.name: OptiWave
records.tagline: Fixing what the others broke.
records.description: OptiWave is the ultimate WordPress speed optimization plugin. Automate Layer 1 zero-PHP caching, Cloud Critical CSS, and sub-second Core Web Vitals.

records.name: Angry Shapes RTS
records.tagline: Throw your army in a free offline RTS for iPhone
records.description: A black-and-white RTS where you throw troops into position, capture energy nodes and keep them connected to your base. Towers spend energy with every shot. Play 20 missions or skirmish on iPhone, or try the browser version. Free, with no ads, in-app purchases or account required.

records.name: SonusVid
records.tagline: Your song deserves a music video.
records.description: Turn any song into a cinematic music video in minutes. SonusVid's AI reads your track, storyboards it and renders a watermark-free MV for YouTube & TikTok. Free to start, no credit card.

records.name: POWR POS
records.tagline: POS System for Restaurants and Retail | POWRPOS
records.description: Run restaurants and retail stores with POWRPOS for checkout, payments, inventory, loyalty, employees, online sales, and real-time reporting.

records.name: OnlinePuzzle
records.tagline: Free browser puzzles in English, Spanish and Portuguese
records.description: Play free puzzle games online: Minesweeper, 2048, Word Search, Mahjong and solitaire. No download or sign-up, with game progress saved in your browser.

records.name: inifnit yield script
records.tagline: Free Roblox admin commands script with fly, speed, noclip
records.description: Infinite Yield is a free and lightweight admin command script for Roblox. It allows players to use useful commands like fly, speed, noclip, teleport, and many others. Easy to set up and regularly updated for the latest Roblox versions.

records.name: techconfessions.lol
records.tagline: the most hilarious tech confessions on the internet!
records.description: A confession booth for developers, founders and vibe coders. Tap the mic, confess in 30 seconds, and it posts as anonymous text. Strangers absolve it, burn it, or hit "same".

records.name: Commerce.design
records.tagline: Discover, collect, and share e-commerce design inspiration.
records.description: "What was that site again, the one that blew me away?" "I have no idea where to start on this new project." Commerce.design is where e-commerce design references live. Browse for inspiration, keep it organized, and share it with your team when the next brief lands. Free, growing every day, built with the community. Including you.

records.name: IDPhotoTool
records.tagline: Passport and visa photos in your browser
records.description: Create passport, visa and ID photos for 100+ countries. Adjust size, cropping and background online, then download digital or printable versions.

records.name: PlanSpark AI
records.tagline: Turn vague ideas into a Lean Canvas in a 5-min AI chat
records.description: PlanSpark AI acts as your Silicon Valley startup coach. Have a 5-minute interactive chat, bulletproof your business logic, and generate an actionable, subscription-ready Lean Canvas for the US/EU market.

records.name: Jeeves
records.tagline: Turn repeat work into reusable AI workflows
records.description: Jeeves is a desktop app for reusable AI workflows. Set up the steps for a task, run them with your input, and review the result. Start with a weekly update: notes in, draft and check, update out. Change the steps in a visual editor and reuse them next week. Add human input when the workflow should wait for you. Free and open source for Mac, Windows, and Linux.

records.name: Tessera
records.tagline: Every game asset you own, with its license on record
records.description: A free, open source library for the game assets you collect. Tessera keeps every pack whole, puts its license and where it came from on record, and sends it into Unity, Godot or Unreal with the credits written for you. Search a hundred thousand files in milliseconds, preview models, sounds and fonts without unpacking anything, and let an AI agent do the filing on your terms. It runs on your own computer: no account, nothing uploaded, and your library stays ordinary folders.

records.name: Jeevan Tech Digital Innovation
records.tagline: seo
records.description: Generative content vs human content explains what Google really rewards, how content quality is evaluated, and how to align with modern SEO standards.

records.name: CreatorFlow
records.tagline: A creator CRM for your TikTok Shop affiliate program
records.description: CreatorFlow replaces DMs and spreadsheets with one dashboard for your TikTok Shop affiliate program. Creators apply through your own branded portal, videos and views get tracked automatically (no manual scrolling), and approval/shipment emails send themselves. Unlike TikTok's built-in Affiliate Center, you get per-creator trackable links with optional tiered commissions, a 0-100 Creator Score to flag who's worth resampling, and flat-fee UGC payouts alongside commission deals.

records.name: Claim Your Gift Card Reward Today!
records.tagline: 🎁 Your Next Gift Card Could Be Just a Click Away!
records.description: 🎁 Looking for a gift card? Discover available gift card offers and rewards. Check out the details and see what’s available for you! ✨ 👉 Click the link to learn more. https://omg10.com/4/11899318

records.name: assistro
records.tagline: Automate WhatsApp Messaging and Business Workflows
records.description: Integrate WhatsApp API and bump your game with the best and easy Whatsapp API integration without BSP. Easy WhatsApp integration with zero code.

records.name: Aspire
records.tagline: Aspire IAS | Best IAS Coaching in Delhi for UPSC Exams
records.description: Searching for the Best IAS Coaching in Delhi? Explore Aspire IAS for UPSC courses, personalised mentorship and practical preparation resources. Build your foundation in General Studies, strengthen CSAT skills and develop clear Mains answers through regular writing practice. Access current affairs, newspaper analysis, previous year questions, daily quizzes and subject notes to support consistent revision. Choose from online and recorded programmes, including Geography Optional, Prelims and Mains

records.name: Auto Loan Calculator
records.tagline: Free Auto Loan Calculator for Accurate Car Payment Estimates
records.description: Auto Loan Calculator helps users estimate monthly car loan payments quickly and easily. Calculate principal, interest, and total repayment costs to understand car financing options before choosing a vehicle.

records.name: Sankey Studio
records.tagline: Turn flow data into clear Sankey diagrams
records.description: Sankey Studio turns plain text or small CSV, TSV, Markdown, or JSON files into clear Sankey diagrams. Start from income statements, household budgets, energy flows, or your own data; adjust spacing, colours, sorting, and zoom; then export SVG or PNG. It runs without an account and includes a local parsing fallback when AI normalization is unavailable. Built for analysts, students, operators, and anyone who needs to explain how quantities move.

records.name: DhaagaCraft
records.tagline: Handcrafted artisanal goods & traditional crafts
records.description: DhaagaCraft is a curated online marketplace dedicated to showcasing authentic handcrafted products and traditional crafts. We connect local artisans with people who appreciate high-quality, handmade artistry. From unique home decor to artisanal goods, explore timeless crafts made with passion and precision.

records.name: CrispCV
records.tagline: Free online resume and CV builder
records.description: CrispCV is a free resume and CV builder that works entirely in your browser. There is no account to create and no payment at the end: the PDF you download is the one you see in the preview. - 10 professional templates, including ATS-friendly one-column designs and photo CVs - Live preview that matches the downloaded PDF exactly - Export to PDF, Word (DOCX), plain text, Markdown and JSON - Built-in suggestions that score your resume and point out what to improve - Cover letter builder

records.name: Candy Wonder Rush Mobile Game
records.tagline: Candy Wonder Rush
records.description: Welcome to Candy Wonder, a classic and colorful Match-3 puzzle game designed for fun, relaxation, and brain-teasing entertainment! Key Features: 🍬 Classic Match-3 Mechanics: Swap and match 3 or more delicious candies to clear the board. 🚀 Powerful Boosters: Unlock and blast special candy combos to clear tricky obstacles. 🎯 Hundreds of Fun Levels: Engaging puzzles that gradually test your matching skills.

records.name: RIZZER
records.tagline: Rizz AI wingman that rates your face and writes your replies
records.description: RIZZER started as a reply writer for dating apps. Now it rates your face too. Attractiveness test: drop a photo and get a score out of 100, the points each part of your face adds or costs (eyes, nose, jaw, skin, hair) and tips for a better photo.
