records.tagline: Produce pitch perfect launch videos with precise control
records.description: Pexo makes creating your launch video as simple as having a conversation. Share your product, website, or assets. It plans the story, chooses the right AI model for each task, generates and assembles the scenes, and handles voiceover, music, captions, motion graphics, and editing. Leave a comment or circle what you want changed, and Pexo makes the edit. You direct one agent from idea to a finished, on-brand launch video.

records.name: Maliklang-V4
records.tagline: Space Cyber Security & SEIT Radio Decoder under 512MB
records.description: Maliklang-V4 is a space-grade hybrid engine integrating 4 fields: Aerospace Avionics, HMAC-SHA256 Cryptography, SETI Radio Decoder, & Embedded Data Vaults. Optimized under 512MB RAM with self-healing code automation. 100% open-source under MIT License.

records.name: CoIsland
records.tagline: Your whole engineering stack, in a notch
records.description: CoIsland watches CI, deploys, errors, incidents and databases (35+ connectors) and shows only what breaks, in an island on the edge of your Mac's screen. Monitors are plain SQL or shell files. One click hands an alert to Claude Code, Codex or Cortex Code.

records.name: Overpath
records.tagline: Your AI Teammate for Revenue Execution
records.description: The CRM records the deal. Intelligence tools analyse it. Overpath is what happens next. Molly is an AI teammate for revenue teams - grounded in your methodology, your deals, your context. Molly flags the gap before the call, draft the follow-up before you ask, and show every manager exactly how the pipeline is really being run. No memory loss between chats. No generic advice. No CRM has ever made a rep sell better. Overpath does.

records.name: Upsolve Data Models
records.tagline: Teach AI your metric definitions and business vocabulary
records.description: Register your data model, metric definitions and business vocabulary once. Upsolve grounds every agent answer in them, versions them like code and refreshes column values nightly, so answers stay correct as your data changes.

records.name: Campfire
records.tagline: The shared workspace for humans and coding agents
records.description: Campfire gives humans and coding agents a shared place to work. Run the coding agents you already use and bring their sessions, context, decisions, and progress together in one workspace. Open source and harness-independent.

records.name: Flocker Agent Profiles
records.tagline: Profile Pages for Agents: your live AI collaboration network
records.description: Never lose context again! Give your Agent a profile page, live feed, and personal storage. Access it anywhere, and connect more to build your private agent network. Give every agent a job title! AI works better with a clear job description. Log-in and ask your agent to create a new Agent Profile for self-managed context, collaborative agent workflows and task management. Works with all your favourite AI tools incl. Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and OpenClaw.

records.name: Squint
records.tagline: Drag a box on your screen and ask AI about it
records.description: Most AI tools make you screenshot, switch to a chat tab, upload, and switch back. Squint cuts that to one step: press a hotkey, drag a box over anything on your screen, and ask. The answer appears right beside what you selected, and you can ask follow-ups. Fast mode usually starts answering in 1-2 seconds; Best mode gives deeper answers. Built in Rust with native screen capture for speed. Works on Windows 10/11 and Linux (Wayland), with a free tier of 3 captures a day.

records.name: NotchDodo
records.tagline: NotchDodo turns your notch into a full-blown dashboard.
records.description: NotchDodo turns your Mac’s notch into a useful part of your everyday workflow. 🦤 With 14 built-in tools, NotchDodo gives you quick access to handy utilities without interrupting your work. It’s lightweight, simple, and designed specifically for Macs with a notch. Instead of working around the notch, make it useful. 14 tools. One notch. A more useful Mac.

records.name: Aktar
records.tagline: Share files instantly from your own cloud. Mac, Windows, iOS
records.description: Aktar is a free, open-source app for instantly sharing files through your own S3-compatible storage. Drop a file and Aktar uploads it to S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO or similar storage, then copies the shareable link to your clipboard. Works with any file: screenshots, logs, builds, videos. No accounts, no intermediary servers, and your files stay in your own storage. Available on Mac, Windows and iOS, with Android coming soon.

records.name: OpenShip
records.tagline: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in.
records.description: OpenShip is an open source PaaS that runs on our cloud or your infrastructure. Push your code and OpenShip handles builds, deployments, domains, SSL, monitoring, backups, secrets, and the services your apps depend on. Start fully managed on OpenShip Cloud or self host on your own cloud or on prem. Move between them without changing how you deploy. No proprietary runtime. No vendor lock in. Remove OpenShip and your apps keep running. Deploy anything. Own everything.

records.name: CrawlRaven MCP
records.tagline: Your SEO work, done from your AI agent
records.description: CrawlRaven joins Search Console, GA4, your keyword lists, and a technical crawl of your site into one plan, ranked by impact: what to fix, update and write first. Ask for it in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through our MCP server and get answers from your own data.

records.name: GitBot
records.tagline: Build bots on the coding agent you already use
records.description: GitBot turns a job you keep giving Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode into a bot. Write the instructions once, set what it may touch, and run it in any repo. Each run is a thread you can come back to. Install bots other devs made from the Library, or share yours with a code. ShipGuard, for example, reads your branch and says merge or block, with file and line evidence. Runs on your machine with the logins you already have. Open source. No account, no telemetry.

records.name: Autonomyware
records.tagline: Idea to physical product, engineer anything you can imagine
records.description: Autonomyware turns your idea into an engineered physical product. Start with your vision and let autonomous AI handle the engineering process end to end. Describe what you want to create, then move from product definition through architecture, risk, CAD, BOMs, code, verification, and manufacturing preparation. One AI-native workspace keeps every decision and engineering artifact connected from idea to implementation.

records.name: Macaly Cloud
records.tagline: Build and publish sites with your Claude or ChatGPT
records.description: Add Macaly Cloud to your Claude or ChatGPT and build websites and apps right from the chat. Macaly provides the database, hosting, domain and 70+ skills the code needs to go live, on the subscription you already pay for. Also works in Claude Code, Codex and Grok Bot.

records.name: GhostCopy
records.tagline: Copy on your computer. Paste on your phone.
records.description: GhostCopy is a free, open-source clipboard companion for Mac, Windows and iPhone. Send text, links, images and files up to 10 MB with a desktop shortcut or your phone’s share sheet. Choose which devices receive each clip, revisit your history, and enable end-to-end encryption with your own passphrase. Includes JSON formatting, JWT decoding and colour previews. Mac and Windows are available now; iPhone is in TestFlight and Android is coming soon.

records.name: FrameNotion
records.tagline: Turn any product page into a scroll-stopping video ad
records.description: Paste any product or website URL. FrameNotion analyzes the page, understands the product, pulls out the strongest selling points, and turns them into a ready-to-use 30-second vertical video ad. No scripts. No editing timeline. No starting from scratch. FrameNotion handles the concept, copy, pacing, visuals, and structure automatically — so you can go from a landing page to an ad creative in minutes.

records.name: Bruto
records.tagline: A task board that lives in your repo, for you and your AI
records.description: A brutalist task board for coding with AI. Notes live in your repo: copy the context with one key, or let an agent work the board over MCP and answer in each note. Standing rules, cross-project links and a map of your pages, APIs and tables. Free, open source.

records.name: Ghost Job Checker by Unlisted
records.tagline: Find out if a job posting is still real, for free
records.description: Type the company and the job title, or paste a LinkedIn share link. We check the employer's own careers site and tell you if the role is still open there, when we last saw it, or when it came down. Free, no account. Why it matters: of 619,116 open postings we read from 15 applicant tracking systems, 27.6% have been up more than 90 days. The checker stays free. Unlisted, the job search behind it, is paid, and you can refund your first payment yourself within 7 days.

records.name: LuminVoice
records.tagline: Self-hypnosis sessions written from your own words
records.description: Most sleep and self-hypnosis apps play the same recording to everyone. LuminVoice starts with a short, private chat about what you want to change, then writes a session around exactly what you said and reads it to you in a calm voice as you fall asleep. Fall asleep to it, nap on it or wake up to it. It runs in your browser and installs to your iPhone Home Screen like an app. Your first session is free.

records.name: Lovelle
records.tagline: Stay close to your partner, even when you're apart
records.description: Lovelle is a couples app for the little moments between conversations. Send a Vibe, touch your partner's screen in real time, draw together, share moods, see your distance, save memories, and leave Love Notes on their Home Screen. It's not another place to text. It's a collection of small ways to say “I'm thinking about you” throughout the day.

records.name: ET Ducky
records.tagline: RMM with kernel-level root cause analysis
records.description: ET Ducky is an RMM for Windows and Linux that reads the kernel event stream on every endpoint (ETW on Windows, eBPF on Linux). Every alert gets an automatic root-cause analysis backed by the kernel events that caused it. Remote desktop, patch management, behavioral security, automations, and natural-language reports run from the same agent at every tier. Start on the Free query tier with your own AI key, or take a 30-day trial with 1,000 AI queries and 20 agent seats, no credit card required.

records.name: libyears
records.tagline: How far behind are your dependencies? Measured in years
records.description: libyears reads every repository you maintain and tells you, in years, how far behind each one has drifted. One ledger for the whole portfolio; one report per client you can send with the invoice. Read-only against GitHub, private names never leave your account, five private repositories free.

records.name: m’kay
records.tagline: One voice for all your coding agents, from your phone
records.description: Talk to the AI agents on your Mac from any browser or phone. Other voice apps talk to one assistant. m’kay talks to all your agents: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on your Mac. Ask which one is done, hear its reply, and tell it what to do next from your phone's browser, on the train, or at the gym. It drives the real desktop apps, so your sessions and projects stay where they are. Nothing is sent until you say "yes" to a read-back. Open source: run it all locally, or use the menu-bar Mac app.

records.name: Evlat
records.tagline: Know which AI coding agent is waiting on you
records.description: Evlat is a thin strip on your Mac's screen edge, one ring per Claude Code or Codex session. When one needs a permission or an answer, it turns amber; one click opens its terminal tab. It also tracks long commands and remote servers. Native, no permissions.

records.name: Ombre Gold Seam Mug
records.tagline: "Gold doesn't hide the crack. It honors it."
records.description: Ocean-blue ombre meets molten gold. This hand-repaired mug carries a fracture reborn as a vein of gold — kintsugi philosophy in daily ritual form. No two repairs are alike; the gold seam you see is the mug's own history, made luxurious. Part of the GOLDBREAK collection.

records.name: Compact Contacts for iPhone & iPad
records.tagline: Clean up, bulk edit and merge your contacts, privately
records.description: Compact Contacts now runs on iPhone and iPad. The private workspace we built for Mac now works on the contacts already on your iPhone and iPad, in one universal purchase. • Dense, readable rows with the fields you choose • Search any field: names, numbers, companies, notes • Bulk Edit with a before/after preview • Merge Studio: pick each field, preview, undo • Smart Views like Missing Phone or Recently Edited No account, no contact cloud, no subscription, no ads.

records.name: BayStacker
records.tagline: Shop software that catches comebacks before cars leave
records.description: BayStacker runs the whole transmission job on one case. The complaint, the VIN, the hypothesis, the build sheet, verification, and the invoice stay in one place. The invoice waits for verification, and verification waits for the build. Warranty rework reopens the original order. Founding shops pay $99 per location, locked. 90-day pays-for-itself guarantee or a full refund.

records.name: HyperFrontend
records.tagline: Compose any web app, however old, without a rewrite
records.description: HyperFrontend lets teams compose independently deployed web apps, even across frameworks and eras, without forcing a shared build or rewrite. Each feature stays isolated in its own browsing context and communicates through typed, validated contracts with lifecycle supervision and optional encryption. It works at build time or runtime, is MIT licensed, and ships with zero runtime dependencies.

records.name: DataBuks
records.tagline: DataBuks AI Sales Agent
records.description: Most AI sales tools spray generic messages and hope. DataBuks is different: it learns your business from your website, discovers real local prospects, and scores every lead with visible evidence — you see exactly WHY each lead qualifies. Outreach runs on WhatsApp, Instagram, LinkedIn & Email, but nothing sends without your one-click approval. Human-like Hinglish/English replies, auto follow-ups, and suggested meetings the moment intent is clear. Built for SMBs. Dogfooded daily on our own sales

records.name: Cylist
records.tagline: The All-in-One Workspace for SOC Analysts
records.description: Cylist is a security investigation workspace built for SOC analysts — combining IOC enrichment, AI-assisted verdicts, threat intelligence, investigation context, and incident case creation in one place. Investigate IPs, domains, URLs, and hashes across multiple intelligence sources, understand the context behind each indicator, and turn your findings into actionable cases without jumping between tools.

records.name: ShieldCI
records.tagline: Catch Laravel security, performance & reliability issues
records.description: ShieldCI runs 155 automated checks over your Laravel app - security, performance, reliability, code quality, and best practices - then shows you the file, the line, and the fix. Start free with the open-source package (73 checks, `composer require`, no account). Connect the dashboard to track your score over time and catch issues right in your pull requests.

records.name: Scrumcaster
records.tagline: A video game announcer for your standups
records.description: Type a work phrase like "DEPLOYED ON A FRIDAY!" and an arena announcer shouts it back. Play it on your standup call, post the MP3 in Slack, or share the link. The Hall of Fame is free to play, and new accounts get 3 free shouts, no card needed.

records.name: ZeroHook
records.tagline: Let's stop spoofed email and ship audit proof today.
records.description: ZeroHook is DNS and email security for teams that need audit proof, not another spreadsheet. One-off scans and alerts with no record to paste leave you guessing when mail fails or an auditor asks what you monitored. ZeroHook runs scheduled audits on your domains, gives you the exact record to paste when something breaks, and keeps a timestamped evidence trail for NIS2 and SOC2-style reviews. Catch spoofing and drift before customers notice. Export the history when compliance shows up.

records.name: Argos TraderBot
records.tagline: Automate your Binance trading strategies without coding
records.description: Argos TraderBot lets you automate your Binance trading strategies without coding. Build custom automations using Monitors, Automations, and Actions — track market data, trigger bots, and execute trades based on your own rules. Includes backtesting tools, risk management, signal-based execution, and Futures trading (Beta). Start with a 7-day free trial. Plans from $15/month.

records.name: Token Monster
records.tagline: Desktop monsters that eat your Claude & Codex usage limits
records.description: Token Monster puts a hungry little monster on the edge of your Windows screen for each AI subscription you use. His plate of treats is what's left of your Claude or Codex 5-hour limit. Use the AI anywhere (desktop app, VS Code, web, terminal) and he eats a treat while his belly grows. When the window resets, the food comes back. One free, open-source file: hover to slide him out, drag him to either edge, and connect with the official sign-in.

records.name: SICKO PSYCHO: My Name Is
records.tagline: Ethereal Beings Are Among Us.
records.description: SICKO PSYCHO: My Name Is — a 100% owned, micro-budget horror franchise built to hit 2,000 theaters, from SICKO PSYCHO Films LLC. A character blending The Joker's chaos, Leprechaun's mischief, and Venom's charisma, with his own swag. Backed by an autonomous AI operating system and a programmatic CTV campaign. Every number here is real and verifiable.

records.name: Data Backed Design
records.tagline: One UI/UX question, one clear answer backed by real products
records.description: Data Backed Design is a research assistant for UI, UX, and design process questions. It cites evidence from real teams. Each answer - Gives you one clear direction - Explains the reasoning - Cites specific companies and systems by name - Calls out when sources disagree and what the tradeoffs are For product designers, PMs, and engineers who keep getting pulled into “what’s the right pattern here?” debates and want to ground those decisions in what trusted products actually do.

records.name: Offhand: Private Voice Notes
records.tagline: transcription, recorder, summary, voice, notes, offline
records.description: Offhand records voice notes and meetings and turns them into structured notes with AI that runs 100% offline on your phone. Encrypted, open source, free.

records.name: MJvortex
records.tagline: AI, coding and useful tools in one workspace
records.description: MJvortex is a growing workspace that brings AI, coding and practical developer tools together in one place. It includes an AI assistant, Python tools, calculator, test generator, Telegram tools and more. The goal is to build a flexible ecosystem where useful tools can live together instead of being scattered across different apps.

records.name: Printer Inspect
records.tagline: Test your printer. Find the problem.
records.description: PrinterInspect is a free browser-based toolkit for testing and troubleshooting printers. Check color, black & white, CMYK, grayscale, print quality, alignment, margins and scaling, or investigate problems like faded prints, missing colors, lines, streaks, blurry output, blank pages and gaps. Print, inspect, identify the issue, and find the right test all in one place.

records.name: MyGully11
records.tagline: Free fantasy cricket, scoring & auctions for local leagues
records.description: MyGully11 turns your local cricket - gully, office, society, college - into a fantasy league. Free contests with people you actually play with, offline ball-by-ball scoring, player auctions, and tournaments that run themselves. No real money, ever.

records.name: HandoverBoat
records.tagline: A shared evidence record for every charter handover
records.description: HandoverBoat gives charter bases and marinas a shared evidence record for every handover, not just a folder of phone photos. A 27-zone inspection (16 critical, 11 optional) runs at check-in and check-out, about 45 minutes. Every photo is hashed with SHA-256, timestamped on the server, and bound into a paired before/after PDF with a public verify link either side can open independently. Runs fully offline. From €8/month per boat, scaling with fleet size. Web, iOS and Android, in 8 languages.

records.name: gym8ed
records.tagline: track, analyse, and compare your Bodybuilding with others
records.description: gym8ed is a modern workout tracker built for strength training, progress and performance analysis. Track your workouts, monitor strength development and analyze training volume, estimated 1RM, muscle workload and more. See how your performance changes over time, discover which muscles you train most and share your workouts with the community. Track. Analyze. Progress. Compare.

records.name: HQ
records.tagline: The company brain your AI runs on
records.description: Today everyone uses AI their own way. HQ gets your whole team working as one. A workspace that makes your AI smarter the more you use it, and turns one person's wins into the whole team's default. You get sharper. They get faster.

records.name: SnapTrace
records.tagline: Real-time error tracking. Built for AI coders & modern apps.
records.description: Lightweight <5KB error monitoring and crash telemetry for Next.js, Python, Node, and JavaScript with zero alert fatigue, client-side PII scrubbing, and BYOK AI root-cause diagnostics.

records.name: Agent Identity
records.tagline: Give every AI agent real identities, inboxes, and a phone
records.description: AI agents are starting to access APIs, databases, SaaS tools, and other agents but most identity infrastructure wasn't built for them. Agent Identity gives every agent a persistent identity, credentials, permissions, and an audit trail, so developers can control what their agents can access and what they do. Built for developers building real agentic systems.

records.name: TangoEra
records.tagline: Your decision profile, backed by data
records.description: TangoEra is a decision-making tool built around one idea: your outcomes are predicted less by who you are than by how you decide. A quiz maps your decision profile — how you weigh risk, handle trade-offs, and where you stall. A built-in decision log then turns your real choices into data, so the profile sharpens with every decision you record. In free beta: 3 Starter report seats open daily.

records.name: Utilboxes
records.tagline: 129 free PDF & image tools that never upload your files
records.description: Utilboxes is a collection of 129 free browser-based tools: merge, split, compress and convert PDFs; compress, resize and convert images; word counters and text cleaners; JSON and Base64 tools; and calculators for EMI, GPA, BMI, percentages and more. File tools process everything locally in your browser, so documents never leave your device. There's no account, no upload queue and no daily limit.

records.name: ZUUZ
records.tagline: AI that finds the deals your CRM never recorded
records.description: ZUUZ sits on top of the CRM your team already runs. It connects to your sales inbox, calendar, meetings and LinkedIn messages, finds the leads, pricing requests and renewal signals that never reached the CRM, and prepares updates for a person to approve. Works with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Attio and Pipedrive. Ask your pipeline from Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or any MCP client. 30-day free trial, no credit card. Or take the Prospect Discovery Challenge: five missing prospects, or $100 (US only).

records.name: lurk
records.tagline: Free, open-source Reddit and Twitter lead monitoring
records.description: lurk watches Reddit and X for people asking for a product like yours, scores each post with a one-line reason, and sends new ones to email, Slack, Discord or a webhook. Also finds the Reddit threads Google ranks for you. Free and open source.

records.name: Rizz Me
records.tagline: AI wingman. AirDrop a link, get her number - Free
records.description: Rizz Me is an AI wingman for shy guys in the wild. Instead of freezing mid-conversation, you AirDrop (or hand over) a short link — she talks to a charming AI for 30 seconds, then you get her contact + a ready-to-send opener. What’s different: no signup, no creepy profile scrape, and results land on your phone — not hers. Go 1:1 AirDrop, classic phone handoff, or multi-drop the same link to everyone nearby and stack replies live. Built for bars, parties, and “I saw her across the room” moments.

records.name: Chirpbroadcasting
records.tagline: Radio revival
records.description: CHIRP combines real-time push-to-talk, live maps, driver networking, and local advertising in one platform. Unlike traditional CB radios, it uses smartphones. Unlike navigation apps, communication is the priority. CHIRP ZERO removes sign-ups and setup, letting drivers connect instantly. Our advertising model is designed to generate revenue without interrupting legitimate conversations, creating a new opportunity for local businesses to reach drivers.

records.name: LunarClip
records.tagline: youtube shorts,tiktok
records.description: Clips are found, framed and captioned on your own computer — nothing is uploaded, nothing waits in a queue.

records.name: Markdown Visual
records.tagline: A fast, local-first Markdown viewer and editor
records.description: A fast, local-first Markdown viewer and editor. Open a file, see the folder around it, and read, search, and edit in one small window — on your machine only. Three views: Preview, Split (live), Editor (CodeMirror 6 with Markdown highlighting) Workspace sidebar respectinggitignore, recent files/folders Full-text search across your workspace Safe saving with conflict detection and crash recovery No telemetry, no accounts, no cloud — 100% local

records.name: Fermata
records.tagline: Native macOS software factory for Claude Code
records.description: A native macOS software factory for Claude Code. Coding agents plan, build, review, and open pull requests on your Mac. Isolated git worktrees, interactive spec interviews, and a visual Loop board. You supervise. It opens the PR. You merge.

records.name: CSVTools
records.tagline: Convert CSV, JSON, XML & Excel — offline, no row limit
records.description: CSVTools converts between CSV, JSON, XML and Excel — all directions — 100% offline. Nothing is uploaded. It streams row by row, so a 5-million-row file converts in flat memory with no row limit. Drag a file in, pick a format, click Convert; leave the output blank and it saves next to your input. Free Demo is a pure converter; Lite and Full add a visual editor to clean, filter, rename, dedupe and reshape — and save reusable jobs. No terminal required.

records.name: Pluginos Pay What You Want
records.tagline: Let customers name their price, make an offer, or donate
records.description: Pluginos Pay What You Want brings flexible pricing to Shopify without changing the way merchants manage their products. Customers can name their price, make an offer, choose preset amounts, or donate. Merchants stay in control with minimum, suggested, and maximum price limits, flexible pricing rules, and customizable display options. Use it for pay-what-you-want products, donations, tips, special offers, and more.

records.name: DecGuard
records.tagline: Reliability testing for probabilistic AI decisions.
records.description: Reliability testing for probabilistic AI decisions in system-one-models: you describe the decision once in a small Decision Contract, run a dataset through any backend, and get one reproducible reliability report with CI-friendly PASS / WARN / FAIL gates. DecGuard measures accuracy and calibration, fuzzes behavioral invariants, compares model versions, and checks production records offline.

records.name: BluPrint
records.tagline: Every answer from the memory your business built
records.description: Every business runs on what's in people's heads. But what if they're busy, on leave or gone? BluPrint keeps it. It's the place for everything your team does and knows, it turns everyday work into your business Brain by having the Associate store and recall what it learns. Ask it anything, and it only answers with what you're allowed to see. Nothing changes without your approval. No per-seat fees. Start with $10 free credit.

records.name: Agentkind
records.tagline: Portable on-chain identity for AI agents
records.description: Agentkind gives every AI agent a portable, verifiable on-chain identity — one record buyers can inspect before paying. Names are matched exactly, case-sensitive, against a public registry, so 'Agent' and 'agent' can't impersonate each other. Independent verification tests are published with methods and results, pass or fail. No theater, just receipts.

records.name: Local Lead Scraper
records.tagline: Pull local business leads directly from your own machine
records.description: Tired of paying bloated monthly SaaS subscriptions just to pull local business leads? The Local Lead Scraper is a lightweight, local-first utility designed for solo developers, agencies, and marketers who want total ownership of their prospecting data. Instead of relying on restricted cloud APIs and recurring monthly bills, you run the extraction process entirely on your own hardware, exporting clean contact data straight into your workflow.

records.name: omadesign — native Linux creative suite
records.tagline: Native Linux creative suite, written in Rust
records.description: Omadesign is a native Linux creative suite, written in Rust and open source under MIT. Vector design, painting, and motion share one app. ARM64 and x86_64 builds install with one line into ~/.local, and the installer writes nothing to /usr.

records.name: EventQuiz
records.tagline: Questions on the big screen, answers from the room's phones
records.description: Run a live quiz at your event. Questions go on the projector, players answer on their own phones with a PIN and a nickname, no app and no accounts. Four modes: quiz, survivor, survey and lucky draw. Pictures in questions, AI written questions, and closest number questions where the room types a number. $39 buys 72 hours of live time with unlimited sessions inside it, not a single game. Measured with 1,000 players in one room and zero dropped answers.

records.name: Game Arena — Play. Compete. Level Up.
records.tagline: One arena. Multiple games. Endless challenges.
records.description: Game Arena is a web-based gaming platform where players can discover and play multiple games in one place. Earn XP, collect coins, unlock achievements, maintain streaks, compete on leaderboards, and progress across games. We're building Game Arena to make browser gaming feel more connected, replayable, and rewarding—with new games and challenges added over time.

records.name: Beyond25
records.tagline: AI playlist curation for any mood, on any music app
records.description: Every AI playlist tool I've tried either locks you into Spotify or spits out the same top-40 tracks no matter what you asked for. Beyond25 actually researches — ask for something specific and you get real deep cuts, not five familiar singles. It also edits playlists you already have instead of making you start over, works with Apple Music and YouTube Music directly, exports anywhere else, and now builds a taste profile on its own as you use it.

records.name: HERO WORLD
records.tagline: browser-based game
records.description: HERO WORLD is a browser game in 9 languages with a real-world mission: inform people worldwide about Russia’s aggression against Ukraine, counter propaganda, and raise funds to help those affected. Play, learn, share, and support Ukraine and other humanitarian causes. Good will save the world!

records.name: cards.company
records.tagline: Group cards for work. Share a link, the whole team signs.
records.description: Group cards the whole office can sign. Share a link: no sign-ups, no app. Everyone adds a note with a photo, GIF or sticker, in one of handwriting and type styles. Schedule delivery for the right moment, and the recipient opens a real keepsake: a cover to open, a board of notes, and a slideshow to play for the room. They can save it as an image or PDF, reply with a thank-you, and keep in touch with colleagues. Free to start, no ad trackers.

records.name: AI Slop Detector
records.tagline: Spot AI slop on Reddit, X, LinkedIn & YouTube as you scroll
records.description: AI Slop Detector marks the posts in your Reddit, X, LinkedIn and YouTube feeds as you scroll: red for AI slop, blue for posts an AI helped write that are still worth reading, and green for human. Tap a label to see why, in one sentence about that post. Disagree? Overrule it and your call sticks. A tolerance slider sets how strict it is, and you can fade, blur or hide slop. Free for 100 checks a day, $3/mo for Unlimited, or $5 once with your own OpenRouter key.

records.name: BhaiFinder
records.tagline: Share once. Bhai remembers forever. 🤙
records.description: BhaiFinder is an AI memory app for India. Save any reel, link, photo, or visiting card from any app via the share sheet — Bhai auto-tags everything in under 3 seconds. Find anything later with vague search — "that Rishikesh place" or "Ford mechanic card" — found instantly. Also does OCR on visiting cards. Nudge reminders that won't quit. BharatAI Solutions Private Limited Product, bootstrapped, from India 🇮🇳 Free to start.

records.name: RxFilmStudio
records.tagline: Create and edit Product videos with your AI Agent
records.description: Create and edit videos by simply telling AI what you want. RxFilm Studio turns ideas, websites, screenshots, footage, and screen recordings into polished videos, then lets you refine every scene with natural language. Make precise edits to timing, layouts, animations, transitions, voiceovers, music, and subtitles without regenerating the whole video. You can also record product demos with smart cursor tracking and automatic click zooms—all in one AI-native video workspace.

records.name: Styx
records.tagline: An agentic development environment (ADE) for Mac
records.description: The desktop app where your work converges: every repo you touch, the AI agents building in them, and every login they need to ship. One window for all of it, and nothing crosses into production without you. Mac now, Windows soon.

records.name: freddy.health
records.tagline: talk to your body in Claude, ChatGPT, Muse, or any other AI
records.description: Connect your Garmin, Polar, Oura, Withings, Intervals.icu, Hevy, WHOOP, Suunto, Concept2 and more to ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, or any AI that speaks MCP. Sleep, recovery, HRV, workouts, queryable in natural language.

records.name: Veridica Voice AI
records.tagline: AI-powered voice analysis for structured interviews
records.description: Veridica Voice AI is a professional platform for structured voice interviews and interview intelligence. It combines speaker verification, acoustic analysis, semantic consistency, session recording, and professional reporting in one workflow — without treating voice analysis as proof of deception.

records.name: TheGameYou
records.tagline: Turn your real-life goals into playable quests.
records.description: TheGameYou is different because it focuses on execution, not just planning. Instead of giving users another static productivity plan, it turns a real-life objective into an personalized evolving RPG style Journey with Levels and Quests. Users can set goals, see the larger path toward it, and get clear actions to complete each day.

records.name: Pullsy Store
records.tagline: Link-in-bio store that DMs your link to anyone who comments
records.description: Creators pay for two tools: a link-in-bio page, and a comment-to-DM bot. Pullsy Store is both, in one place. Build a page with links, free downloads, email sign-ups and webinars. Then pick an Instagram post and a keyword: everyone who comments it gets your link in a DM from your account, via Instagram's official API. The page is free forever. Auto-DM and analytics are one flat fee in rupees, with a 14-day free trial and no card. Selling products is coming, at 0% commission.

records.name: PostIQ
records.tagline: Turn Instagram DMs into 24/7 sales, on autopilot
records.description: PostIQ is the ultimate automation tool for Instagram creators, influencers and businesses. Automate comment-to-DM flows, handle auto-replies with chatbot flows, ice breakers, rich media, and buttons. Generate AI content and track analytics without paying a dime.

records.name: Dental Scope
records.tagline: Explore dental anatomy in 3D, tooth by tooth
records.description: Dental Scope is a free, open source 3D dental learning tool for exploring teeth and surrounding structures in detail. Explore all 32 permanent teeth, switch between FDI, Universal and Palmer numbering systems, and study structures from enamel and dentin to pulp, root canals, jaws, nerves and vessels.

records.name: Bevell
records.tagline: CAD automation where it counts.
records.description: Stop redrawing parts by hand. Turn a photo, sketch, scan or PDF into a file you can cut, mill or print. Get an editable DXF and true-scale SVG. Preview unlimited conversions for free. Bevell Sketchpad now in beta.

records.name: Foglio
records.tagline: Simple, private docs with smart AI templates, zero bloat.
records.description: The simple document editor for everything you create. Private, clutter-free editing with smart templates for contracts, invoices, meeting notes, and more. Free forever.

records.name: skink
records.tagline: Email verification API with calibrated confidence
records.description: Real-time email verification API — actual SMTP handshakes, not just syntax checks. Resolves catch-alls, even behind Proofpoint/Mimecast, where most tools return "unknown." Every result ships reasons[] and a calibrated confidence score, never laundered into a false "deliverable." MCP server for Claude/Cursor, or bulk CSV. Unknown results are free. We verify your list and stop there — encrypted at rest, retention you set. 100 free credits, no card.

records.name: AI iD Card+S.I.M.O.N. powered by DigMoon
records.tagline: AI continuity and AI multi-agent collaboration
records.description: AI iD Card offers a Specialized Agent that does not drift back to their default mode. Continuity of project, No Identity drift, no AI Amnesia, No prompting, and No Temporal Drift. S.I.M.O.N. (Supervised Intelligence Multi-agent Operational Network) Collaborate with your AI team in one workspace.

records.name: Invoice Mitra
records.tagline: 20+ free GST tools for Indian businesses.
records.description: Invoice Mitra is a free GST toolkit for Indian freelancers, shops, SME and MSMEs not a single invoice form. Create a GST invoice with no signup, then stay on the same site for the rest of the work: • GST invoice + quotation + WhatsApp PDF • Auto CGST / SGST / IGST, HSN/SAC, GSTIN check • GST, reverse GST, TDS, 44ADA, advance tax • UPI QR + UPI MDR calculator (0.4% fee from 15 Oct 2026) • E-way bill, payment reminder, freelance rate, P&L Unlimited use. No watermark. Data stays in the browser.

records.name: ShowMyProduct
records.tagline: A free public wall of ads for indie builders
records.description: ShowMyProduct is a free, public wall of posters for indie products. Sign in with X, paste a poster (image, GIF, video or just words) with a link, and it goes up on the wall for 30 days. Its product page stays for good. Every maker gets real stats: who saw it, who clicked, from where, and which AI assistants read their page. Visitors can join your email list, answer what you're looking for (beta testers, feedback, early customers) or grab your offer. No card, no ad budget.

records.name: VetoDraft
records.tagline: AI contract risk shield & redline editor for freelancers
records.description: VetoDraft protects freelancers and agencies from toxic client contracts. Upload any agreement to instantly uncover predatory traps: Net-90 payment delays, unlimited liability, bug-free warranty clauses, and IP handover before payment. Unlike generic AI, VetoDraft calculates your real financial risk exposure and generates lawyer-grade redline replacements with ready-to-send counter-offer email scripts. Protect your income without spending $500/hr on lawyers.

records.name: Dicty.io
records.tagline: Offline voice dictation & docs librarian for developers
records.description: Dicty is an offline-first desktop voice assistant built specifically for software engineers: Sub-400ms Local Dictation: Runs Whisper models directly on Apple Silicon Metal and Windows NVIDIA/CPU. Zero audio ever leaves your computer. Architectural Librarian: Connects your voice notes with your Git branch, diffs, and commits to maintain persistent documentation in Obsidian, Notion, or Confluence. Offline Neural Text-to-Voice: High-fidelity read-aloud with Kokoro & Silero.

records.name: ApexCache
records.tagline: REAL-TIME ACCELERATION FOR YOUR APIs
records.description: Real-time acceleration for your APIs: cache GET/HEAD at the edge, pass POST and mutations to origin. Per-route TTLs, purge via webhooks or CDC, optional in-VPC gateway for regulated teams. Point your domain, set policies, watch cache hits in headers. Free tier on app.getapexcache.com. We can supercharge your product before you launch it on producthunt.

records.name: Artis
records.tagline: The AI agent that actually onboards your users for you
records.description: Artis is an AI agent that lives inside your product and actually onboards and implements for your users, not another manual tour builder. It talks, guides, and takes real actions (clicking, configuring, fixing) so people reach value without a support ticket. No MAU penalties, no six-week implementation projects, just an agent that keeps working every time you ship. Built for SaaS teams tired of paying more to onboard fewer people.

records.name: rustcoach
records.tagline: Learn Rust with an AI coach that won't write it for you
records.description: RustCoach teaches Rust by making you write it. An AI coach (built on Claude) writes each lesson for you, remembers what you got wrong, and re-tests it before moving on. Every lesson ends with a real assignment: your code compiles and runs against cargo tests and clippy in a sandbox, then gets reviewed like a pull request. Stuck? You get hints and a line-by-line trace, never the answer. 16 chapters, spaced review cards. Free to start, $49 once, no subscription.

records.name: HighFit
records.tagline: Job fit score & patent-pending Candidate Match Certificate™
records.description: HighFit scores every job posting 0–100 against your resume — right on LinkedIn, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Dice and more — so you apply only to jobs where you're actually a strong candidate. Get a match breakdown, tailored cover letters, LinkedIn intros, interview prep, and a shareable Candidate Match Certificate™. Free to start: 5 credits, no card.

records.name: Attensia
records.tagline: Cognitive games based on real psychology tests
records.description: Attensia brings 62 brain-training games based on established cognitive psychology tests into one ad-free app. Explore Stroop, N-Back, Flanker, Trail Making, working memory, spatial reasoning and more. Train attention, memory, processing speed and reasoning through quick daily sessions, track your progress, and understand what each test measures. Start free with no subscription, then unlock every game with a single lifetime purchase. No ads. No distractions. Just real cognitive challenges.

records.name: getcta.store
records.tagline: an ai teleprompter that lives under your MacBook notch
records.description: getcta is a macOS teleprompter that sits right under your MacBook notch, next to the camera, so your eyes stay on the lens. It follows your voice as you read, highlighting the word you're on and scrolling with you, and it's hidden from Zoom, Meet, OBS and screen recordings. AI helps you write a script from notes, Notion or Google Drive, rewrite it to be easier to say, and fit it to 15s–3min. Speech is recognized on your Mac. Free prompter; Pro is $9/mo.

records.name: Moshimo
records.tagline: Call Japanese businesses without speaking Japanese
records.description: Moshimo helps Japan travelers handle phone-only requests without making the call themselves. Choose a business, write what you need in your language, and an AI-assisted caller calls in Japanese. Track status, summaries, results, and next steps in the app. Use it for restaurants, hotels, onsens, salons, pharmacies, lost items, availability checks, and plan changes. Moshimo is built by Zero Innovavi Limited.

records.name: Kakunin
records.tagline: KYC of AI agents with cryptographic identity
records.description: Kakunin (kakunin.ai) is the leading Know Your Agent (KYA) platform. Issue X.509 cryptographic identities, monitor real-time AI behavior, and generate EU AI Act & MiCA compliance reports.

records.name: SOC 2 Fast-Track Readiness Toolkit
records.tagline: Audit-ready SOC 2 policies & controls matrix for startups
records.description: Save $15,000+ in consultant fees and weeks of audit prep time. The SOC 2 Fast-Track Readiness Toolkit gives early-stage B2B startups and dev shops production-ready, auditor-aligned policy templates (.docx) and an AICPA controls evidence matrix (.xlsx). Includes master security policies, access control, incident response, vendor risk, and a free 1-page baseline readiness checklist. 100% self-contained.

records.name: UluPy
records.tagline: Give any AI agent hands to manage your projects
records.description: Ulupy is the official MCP integration for UluP Spaces. Connect any MCP-compatible AI agent (Claude Desktop, and others) and it can create projects, add nodes, connect them, manage tasks — directly on your visual canvas, not just as text. What's different: most AI project tools just generate lists. Ulupy controls the same map-based canvas you'd use by hand — nodes, connections, tasks — through natural language, with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE so your agent only ever acts as you. 7 tools. Free.

records.name: TopKing
records.tagline: The #1 Real-Time Brand Leaderboard — Outbid Claim the Crown
records.description: TopKing is the world's first open attention marketplace where brands, startups, AI tools, and Telegram channels compete for the #1 position through transparent real-time bidding. 🏆 Real-time brand rankings with WebSocket live updates ⚔️ 1v1 Brand Duels with community voting ⭐ Stars economy — earn, bid, and compete 🌍 23 languages — from English to Japanese to Uzbek 📊 10% weekly decay prevents monopolies 🤖 MCP API for AI agent integration Free to start. Join the global brand ranking revolution!

records.name: Spendhog
records.tagline: A household budget that explains why, with no bank login
records.description: Spendhog is a household budget app with no bank connection. You, or a CSV import, record what happened, and it explains why the month went the way it did: what changed, what was a one-off, and whether you can still afford what you are saving for. A health score you can take apart, forecasts that say how sure they are, budgets for bills that are not monthly, goals tied to real balances. Up to 3 people per household, CHF, EUR and USD. Built in Switzerland.

records.name: Street Whisperer
records.tagline: Turn your next city walk into a personal audio tour
records.description: Walk past a beautiful building and wonder what happened there? Street Whisperer turns nearby landmarks, architecture and hidden corners into audio stories. Wander freely or pick a duration and theme for a tailored walk. New: museum mode with major works explained one by one, weekly rankings and a play button right on your lock screen. Ask your AI guide follow-up questions. iPhone and Android, 15 languages. Free to start, no account required.

records.name: Synclify
records.tagline: The agent that runs your Instagram
records.description: Synclify puts your whole Instagram in one place: content, DMs, brand deals, invoices, analytics, ads, competitors. You ask, the assistant does it, and it checks with you before it changes anything. It never shows you a number it can't back up. Every figure shows where it came from, and if something wasn't measured, it says so instead of showing you a zero. Built for creators, brands and agencies. Each account gets its own workspace, and clients can sign off on a post before it goes out.

records.name: ALT
records.tagline: Windows Excel's Alt and Ctrl shortcuts, now on Mac
records.description: ALT brings familiar Windows ribbon shortcuts to Excel for Mac, so commands like ⌥ H O I are back in your workflow. Every menu row is labeled with its shortcut, letting you navigate Excel entirely from your keyboard. You can even use Ctrl in place of ⌘, just like on Windows. Try ALT at altkeys.app with a 7-day free trial, then buy it for a one-time $10 payment. No subscription. ALT runs locally and never reads your spreadsheets, so your data stays private.

records.name: Zumbo
records.tagline: Open source local AI voice-to-text for Mac for private STT
records.description: Zumbo uses local AI models on your Mac to instantly turn what you say into text, with near perfect accuracy and complete privacy, in every app. About a fifth of a second from the end of your sentence to text in the app. 21 vocabulary packs, from developer tools to legal, medical and design, and it learns from your corrections: wrong once, never again. Notes with reminders, meetings with speaker labels. Works with the Wi-Fi off, no account. One-time price, open source.

records.name: Notely
records.tagline: Turn notes into tasks, with AI that asks first
records.description: Turn scattered notes into tasks, calendar plans, and follow-ups. Notely’s AI assistant searches your notes and connected apps, proposes the steps, and waits for your approval before making changes. Keep your ideas and your work moving together.

records.name: Voice Memo
records.tagline: Open-source voice notes that file your tasks and reminders
records.description: You think of things while walking or driving, record a voice note, and never play it again. Voice Memo does the listening. It pulls out the tasks, decisions, questions and reminders, files them into the right project, and updates the old ones when you change your mind. Reminders ring like an alarm, and Claude can answer questions about your notes. Open source and MIT. You run your own copy on Cloudflare's free tier, so it costs $0 a month and your notes are stored in your own account.

records.name: Rinkata
records.tagline: One source of truth for your team and its AI agents
records.description: Rinkata keeps product intent connected from idea to deploy, so your team and its AI agents build the same thing. Goals, specs, decisions, and completion evidence live in one shared hub that Claude, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok read and write over MCP. Agents search your knowledge before inventing context, humans make the judgment calls, and finished work ships with proof (tests, screenshots, PRs) that writes itself back into your docs.

records.name: WebinarFlow
records.tagline: Your pitch on repeat. You only when it counts.
records.description: Record your demo once. Prospects book and watch whenever suits them. Jump in live only when a real question needs you, then keep the recording rolling. Every answer trains an AI that handles the repeat questions next time.

records.name: Ace from Automat Workforce
records.tagline: Meet Ace, an agentic teammate for work
records.description: Hi! Lucas here from Automat, stoked to share what the team's been heads-down on: Ace. It’s Instinct or Muse but for work. The TL;DR: you can now hire an AI coworker. Ace shows up with its own computer, phone number, inbox, and logins, works inside the tools you already use, and hands back finished work- not just status updates. We’ve got a 14-day free trial, which should make it super easy to try out.. so.. try it out! and let us know what you think.

records.name: Speek
records.tagline: A context aware FOSS voice assistant and dictation for macOS
records.description: Speek is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. Hold a key and talk to dictate into any app, edit selected text, or ask it to take action in your apps and accounts. Point to something on screen by circling it. Speek handles quick requests in the notch and runs longer tasks in the background, then tells you when they are done. It can answer aloud, follow up naturally, and remember details you ask it to keep. Built for macOS.

records.name: SelfJev
records.tagline: Jev-compatible self-hosted decisions mode
records.description: SelfJev is an open 4B decisions model you host yourself. Ask typed questions about any text (yes/no, pick one, pick any, score) and get calibrated probabilities. Jev-compatible: point TypeSafe's SDK at your server with two env vars. Fine-tune it on your data.

records.name: Tracky
records.tagline: Open-source budgeting with a cash flow forecast
records.description: Tracky connects a zero-based budget plan with a day-by-day cash-flow forecast. Start with a manual account, record or import transactions, assign money to categories, and add upcoming expenses. The dashboard shows how those commitments affect your projected balance, including when it could go below zero. Explore reports to understand spending. The hosted app is free to try, and the code is open source under MIT.

records.name: DEVANUM
records.tagline: Deterministic State RAG & AI Infrastructure for Enterprise
records.description: Devanum is an enterprise technology house architecting production-grade platforms, custom software engines, and intelligent AI infrastructure.

records.name: AI Dialer
records.tagline: Reduce manual dialing and improve call productivity
records.description: AI Dialer provides AI-powered business calling, auto and predictive dialers, AI voice agents, owned phone numbers, branded caller ID, business SMS, call recording, analytics, IVR, call queues, and cloud phone features with usage-based pricing.

records.name: Webdesly Social
records.tagline: A focused professional network for people and companies.
records.description: Webdesly Social is a professional network for people and companies — feed, verified profiles, and a job board with clear membership paths.

records.name: Quaryan
records.tagline: One AI hub for SEO, ChatGPT answers, ads and app stores
records.description: Paste your website or app link and Quaryan writes a full marketing plan: SEO fixes, ChatGPT visibility, ads for 7 platforms and app store listings. Publish everywhere in one click; every Monday the AI tunes your ads. Free plan, no card.

records.name: IT Solutions
records.tagline: IT company
records.description: The goal is to design and deliver intelligent, human-centered solutions that empower organizations to innovate faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence, from digital strategy to full-scale transformation.

records.name: SWING - Player Matchmaking
records.tagline: House of sports
records.description: At its core, SWING is a player matchmaking app that connects sports enthusiasts based on sport, skill level, and availability—solving the fundamental challenge of finding partners for casual sports. What We Do - Tournament Infrastructure: A proprietary POS system with live scoring and streaming, alongside corporate tournaments hosted directly on the platform. - Marketplace: B2C sales for apparel and equipment, plus B2B equipment supply for venues and grounds. - Corporate Tournaments

records.name: Aluqab Sales & Distribution Management
records.tagline: Sales, distribution, inventory and field sales platform
records.description: Aluqab Sales & Distribution Management is a web-based platform for companies managing sales, distribution, representatives, inventory, warehouses, invoices, collections and customer debts. It also supports Cash Van and Pre Sale workflows, branch management and business reporting. Built by Aluqab Software in Iraq, the platform helps businesses centralize daily sales and distribution operations from desktop and mobile browsers.

records.name: VIGIA
records.tagline: Live citizen radar of air threats over Europe
records.description: Free web app tracking air threats over Europe in near real time: drones, missiles, air alerts, military traffic (ADS-B) and news on one radar map. No signup, works in your browser, with push alerts to the phone and a Telegram channel posting alerts in English.

records.name: Hodman AI
records.tagline: A shared coding agent for non-programmer teams
records.description: Start from zero or bring your current codebase. Hodman AI helps non-programmer teams build, maintain, fix and validate real web applications together. Import a ZIP, connect Git, work across multiple repositories, preview before launch, publish when ready and keep improving the product in production. Advanced plans support on-premises deployment when infrastructure and data must stay inside your perimeter. Your team keeps ownership of the code and runtime.

records.name: aside
records.tagline: Onboarding and support that act through your app's code
records.description: aside is a chat copilot inside your web app. It walks new users through setup and answers their questions from your docs, acting through the actions your app registers: your own code fills the forms, and you decide what waits for a click.

records.name: TalkPilot
records.tagline: An AI coach that tells you what to say, live!
records.description: TalkPilot helps you in conversations and meetings: it listens and puts the next line on your screen while the other person is still talking! Your context profile tells it who you are: your role, your experience, your notes. So every line sounds like you and uses your real numbers. Use it in interviews, sales calls and every conversation that matters, on your laptop or in person with one earbud in. After the call, your action items are already written. Mac, Windows, iPhone, Android.

records.name: HYPNIX
records.tagline: A living ocean and music-reactive wallpapers for Windows
records.description: Bring your Windows desktop to life with HYPNIX. Unwind with a real-time ocean featuring moving waves, clouds, and a day/night cycle, or enjoy wallpapers that react to your music. Shape the ocean's mood, customize supported visual effects, and give each monitor its own look. No built-in AI. Audio processing stays on your PC, with no recordings or uploads. Try it free for 15 days, then unlock it with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

records.name: Tankly - Fuel Tracker
records.tagline: Fuel tracking and smarter road trip planning
records.description: Tankly helps you track fuel, understand your real-world mileage, and plan smarter road trips. Log fill-ups, monitor fuel costs and efficiency, and see how your vehicle performs over time. Plan trips with route-based fuel estimates, recommended fuel stops, toll costs, and trip expenses. Keep service records, expenses, reminders, documents, and vehicle details organized in one place.

records.name: Popkorn - FREE Text-to-Lottie Generator
records.tagline: Generate free Lottie, MP4, GIF animations with your agent.
records.description: Generate vector animations for free with your own agent via MCP, or with your own API key. Export to Lottie, MP4, or GIF. You can also import and edit existing Lottie files, or bring in your SVGs and animate them with a prompt.

records.name: Sensecast
records.tagline: Most weather apps tell you what. This one tells you why.
records.description: Sensecast turns raw meteorology into something you can act on: an atmospheric science academy built into every metric, live tornado, earthquake, wildfire, and grid intelligence, verifiable storm reports, and 18 forecast sources you can compare side by side. Android: Now on the Play Store! iOS: Coming Soon! macOS: Coming Soon! Windows: Coming Soon! Linux: Coming Soon!

records.name: Content Rewardz
records.tagline: Run clipping campaigns and pay only for real views
records.description: Content Rewardz turns clip campaigns into pay-per-real-view. A brand funds a pool and sets a rate per 1,000 views; hundreds of clippers post short-form across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. On Instagram and YouTube we read the platforms' own official APIs, and a per-account trust score filters bot and fake views before payout - so you only ever pay for real, verified human views. No retainers, pure performance; payouts settle automatically, worldwide.

records.name: SHOT Clubhouse
records.tagline: The clubhouse for the next generation of sport
records.description: SHOT is the clubhouse for the next generation of sport, and the home for everyone who lives it: athletes, coaches, parents, fans, creators and the clubs that hold it all together. Your Sport Head ID is one login that follows you through every team, sport and role. Inside, clubs run free, PERFORM develops every athlete, PULSE brings the scores and stories you follow, and LOCKER brings the kit, drops and patches. Take your shot. Own it. Make impact.

records.name: Halo
records.tagline: A customizable workspace in your Mac’s notch
records.description: Halo turns your Mac’s notch into a customizable workspace for music, lyrics, files, timers, clipboard history, notes, launching apps, system controls, and more. Start with a polished preset—or shape the interface around the way you use your Mac.

records.name: Futurepost: Bulk Unfollow & Follow for X
records.tagline: Safely clean up who you follow and who follows you
records.description: Managing an X account shouldn't take a thousand clicks. Futurepost handles both, right inside your browser and completely free. Bulk unfollow non-followers and inactive accounts, bulk follow the right people, and find bots and fake followers to remove without blocking. Every action is paced to keep your account safe. Plus Bubbles, a visual map of the communities around you, and shareable stats cards. Already 2,000+ users on the Chrome Web Store!

records.name: Downsweep
records.tagline: Sweep installers, duplicates & stale files from Downloads
records.description: Downsweep is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that clears your Downloads folder: installers for apps you already have, byte-for-byte duplicates and files you forgot. Everything goes to the Trash and can be undone. No analytics, no accounts.

records.name: AetherWave Project Studio
records.tagline: Edit video in your browser with AI right on the timeline
records.description: Project Studio is a full timeline video editor in your browser. Five lanes: video, overlay, music, voiceover, text. Keyframe volume, opacity, scale and position by moving a slider. The AI editor works on the real timeline: animate a still, extend a shot from its last frame, bridge two clips, add a voiceover or a score. Normalize audio, master limiter, effects rack. Everything you make on AetherWave is already in your library. Editing and rendering are free.

records.name: Body Workout — Exercise Tracker
records.tagline: Strength, Cardio & Flexibility
records.description: Plan workouts, log strength, stretching and cardio sessions, track progress, calculate calories, and keep your data private in iCloud.🏋️ Track every workout and make your progress visible. Log strength, cardio, and stretching with 200+ exercises, detailed history, personal records, built-in timers, workout plans, and a calendar. Create custom exercises, review detailed workout results, and share your achievements. Your data stays private with iCloud sync, and the app works fully offline.

records.name: PostQuest
records.tagline: Manage your social media with AI agents
records.description: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible AI agent to PostQuest and let it manage your social media on Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and 5 more networks. Your agent writes, schedules, and tracks posts. Before anything is queued, PostQuest checks each platform's rules, like character limits, media formats, and aspect ratios, so problems get caught early. Everything stays a draft until you approve it. No more copy-pasting AI-written posts into another scheduler.

records.name: ZenVoice
records.tagline: Say it messy. Send it clean. Private dictation for Mac
records.description: ZenVoice is private dictation for Mac. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and polished text lands in any app. Speech recognition and ZenPolish run on your Mac, even offline. It removes fillers, formats numbers and times, adapts tone to the app, and lets you review text before inserting it. Choose from 14 on-device models, including Parakeet, Whisper, and Hinglish Prime. No account or subscription.

records.name: BetterViewer
records.tagline: The image viewer your browser should have had
records.description: BetterViewer 3.0 replaces your browser's built-in image viewer. Open any image in a tab and it opens in BetterViewer, ready to zoom, annotate and edit. Crop, straighten, adjust colors, use levels & curves, remove backgrounds with AI, extract text (OCR) and scan QR codes. Add arrows, text, emoji, blur and spotlights. Everything runs on your device, and it's free and open source. Available for Chrome, Firefox and Edge, or try the web version with no install.
