Send the link: they see your time, try to beat it, and every try lands on that link's board. It works in the browser, no app to install.

records.name: DataCleanist
records.tagline: 80% of ML is data cleaning. We do that part.
records.description: DataCleanist checks your dataset with real code before any AI touches it. Upload a CSV or Excel file and get an interactive, column-by-column report: missing values, outliers, duplicates, correlations, distributions, VIF, feature importance, statistical tests, categorical analysis, MCAR/MAR and target leakage. Then ask questions in plain English and let it clean the file. The AI answers from that report, so it cannot invent a number. Your data is never used to train models.

records.name: Groundbase
records.tagline: Budget, draws, and loan tracking for building your own home
records.description: Track your home build budget, draws, and funding in one place. Groundbase is the budget and planning tool built for owner-builders building a custom home.

records.name: FormulaAI
records.tagline: AI Excel that never uploads your files
records.description: FormulaAI generates and edits spreadsheets from plain English — without ever uploading your files to a server. ✨ Generate: Describe what you need → AI creates a complete Excel file 📝 Edit: Upload Excel → describe changes → AI modifies → diff preview → download 🔒 Privacy-first: Files parsed locally in your browser. Only summaries sent to AI. Nothing stored. Free tier with monthly quota. Early supporters get a permanent discount. 👉 formulaai.net

records.name: Avengents
records.tagline: Command your AI coding agents from anywhere, as one team
records.description: Avengents connects the AI coding agents already running on your machines (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Antigravity) to one app on Mac, iPhone, iPad and the web. Pair a machine with one command, then chat with any agent from anywhere, bring people and agents into shared project rooms with live terminals, and let agents message each other so you stop copying context between them. A voice keyboard lets you talk to any agent from any app.

records.name: Stronger Acting Journey | Actors Hub
records.tagline: Staying Creative When Acting Opportunities Become Limited
records.description: Your values can influence the way you approach acting, especially when your career does not develop according to your original expectations. Actors Hub explores how identifying what matters most to you can help create direction during uncertain periods. If creativity, discipline, storytelling, collaboration, or continuous learning are important to you, these qualities can become part of your daily development. A difficult period does not necessarily mean your acting journey has ended.

records.name: Common Safety Harness Standards Today
records.tagline: Understand the standards – Choose the right safety harness
records.description: Safety harnesses are essential equipment for protecting workers when working at height. However, there are still many products on the market that do not meet safety standards, posing serious risks during use. Therefore, understanding safety harness standards is essential for assessing the technical requirements and safety level of the equipment. In this article, Thien Bang will explore the common standards applicable to safety harnesses.

records.name: Dar
records.tagline: AI contractor estimating assistant for instant trade quotes
records.description: Dar is an intelligent multi-agent AI assistant designed to streamline construction and trade estimating. Built specifically for residential and commercial contractors, Dar calculates precise project line items, material quantities, and labor costs in seconds. Automate detailed bid creation, capture high-value trade leads directly on your site, and deliver accurate estimates faster without manual spreadsheet overhead.

records.name: PokerRiskEngine
records.tagline: Know whether you're winning at poker for $10!
records.description: I've always found it hard to answer questions like: How much bankroll do I actually need for the risk I'm comfortable taking? What's a realistic range of outcomes over the next year? How bad could the drawdowns get? What's the probability that I actually reach my bankroll goal? How much does my win rate / variance / volume change the picture? So I built Poker Bankroll Risk Engine to answer those questions with actual simulations rather than just a generic bankroll rule.

records.name: AI Voice Expense Notepad
records.tagline: Smart Expense Tracker
records.description: AI Voice Expense Notepad – Smart Expense Tracker Track your daily expenses and income quickly with AI Voice Expense Notepad, a simple and smart expense tracker designed to make money management easier. Just speak or type your expense in natural language, and the app can help organize your entry into useful expense information. Whether you spend money on groceries, fuel, shopping, bills, food, travel, or other daily needs, you can keep your records organized in one place.

records.name: Sourdough Hydration Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate dough hydration with the starter included
records.description: A sourdough calculator that includes the flour and water in your starter. Check an existing dough’s hydration, calculate the water needed for a target percentage, or scale ingredient weights. The tool shows the flour-and-water breakdown, supports different starter hydrations, and includes local recipe saving, shareable calculation links and printing. English, Spanish, French and Arabic are available.

records.name: Screen Recorder – HD, Minimal
records.tagline: Screen Recorder & Video Capture – HD, No Watermark
records.description: Screen Recorder is a compact Android utility created for practical, everyday capture scenarios — demonstrations, previews, issue reporting, and simple sharing. The application follows the same design philosophy present across edenhall releases: clarity, efficiency, and absence of unnecessary complexity. Screen Recorder is intended for developers, testers, educators, and users who need fast visual capture without friction.

records.name: All File Converter
records.tagline: Convert 90+ formats with custom quality settings in Telegram
records.description: You can contact @all_file_converAll File Converter is a pro-grade conversion workstation directly inside Telegram, supporting 90+ formats and 800+ pairs. Unlike basic bots with poor default compression, you get granular control: PDF print density (up to 300 DPI), video resolution (1080p/720p/480p), audio bitrates (up to 320 kbps), and SVG scaling. Includes OCR text extraction, 1:1 Telegram Video Notes, fonts, and ebooks.

records.name: Madlyzer
records.tagline: Madlyzer — The AI Marketing Operating System
records.description: Madlyzer connects audits, UGC creation, workflow automation, retention, competitor intelligence, and analytics into one unified platform with a shared data layer. Built by THE MADESIGNERS.

records.name: Chat Organizer for Alibaba
records.tagline: Chrome extension to organize Alibaba chats, notes & costs
records.description: Chat Organizer for Alibaba turns Alibaba Messenger into a powerful CRM overlay. Drag-and-drop supplier chats into custom pipeline categories, attach detailed supplier notes, and label contacts with product tags. Features instant search across names, notes, and tags, a built-in real-time Landed-Cost Calculator, and secure cloud sync. Built by e-commerce sellers for Amazon & D2C brands.

records.name: PoE Dust Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate exact dust yields & gold fees in PoE Kingsmarch
records.description: Stop guessing which uniques to disenchant in PoE Kingsmarch. PoE Dust Calculator ranks unique items by Thaumaturgic Dust per Chaos in real time using live poe.ninja market prices. • Accurate ilvl 84 dust formulas & quality multipliers • Faustus currency exchange gold fee calculations • Dust-per-slot efficiency for town shipments & runesmithing • 100% free, zero ads, no login required, privacy-first

records.name: Quick wire
records.tagline: Hi! I just built QuickWrite,
records.description: I built QuickWrite 🚀 An AI writing tool that generates: 📝 Blog posts 💌 Emails 📱 Social posts 🎯 Ad copy 🎬 Video scripts In seconds. Free to try. No credit card needed. Link in bio → https://quickwrite.floot.app Who needs this? 🙋

records.name: Maxify
records.tagline: Maxify Every Message
records.description: Maxify is the all-in-one platform to broadcast, automate, sell, and support on the official WhatsApp Business API - without juggling tools or developers. Maxify is a multi-tenant SaaS/Mobile App, built on the official WhatsApp Cloud API. Connect your number, import contacts, and run growth, sales and support from a single workspace. Smart Inbox, Broadcast Campaigns, Visual Flow Builder, Native WhatsApp Flows, Templates Studio, Automations & APIs

records.name: ICT Edge — Algorithmic Trading Bots
records.tagline: ICT/SMC trading bots — real-time alerts + MT5 automation
records.description: ICT/SMC trading bots for gold, US indices, and crypto — real-time Telegram/Discord alerts with optional automatic execution on MetaTrader 5.

records.name: Cutroom
records.tagline: Turn one talking-head take into a finished video
records.description: Cutroom turns one raw talking-head take into a finished vertical video. It removes dead air, writes the opening hook, styles captions, adds music and places B-roll on the exact words you say. Instead of starting from a blank timeline, you start with a complete edit in minutes — then change shots, captions or text directly from the transcript. Built for creators, agencies, coaches and consultants. First video free, no card.

records.name: Simplyr
records.tagline: A better college planner for iPhone and web
records.description: Simplyr is a college planner for iPhone and web that brings classes, assignments, exams, grades, notes, and study tools into one workspace. Plan your day, week, or semester; track deadlines and grade estimates; and keep study sessions close to your coursework. Start free. Simplyr complements school platforms like Canvas; it does not replace them.

records.name: MarkGone
records.tagline: Remove image watermarks in your browser — free & private
records.description: MarkGone is a free watermark remover that runs entirely in your browser. Brush over any watermark — text, logos, date stamps, semi-transparent marks — or drag a rectangle, and an inpainting engine (Telea FMM + multiscale diffusion) rebuilds the background behind it. Process up to 50 images in parallel with Web Workers, apply one mask to a whole batch. No signup, no file limits, and no watermark on the output.

records.name: Web TV Italia
records.tagline: TV Italia web player
records.description: 🎬TV in chiaro su tutti i dispositivi.

records.name: DocSage
records.tagline: Never Miss a Dose Again our health is your priority
records.description: DocSage is a free medicine reminder app that improves medicine adherence. Build your medication schedule, get smart pill reminders, and track every dose. Free on App Store & Google Play.

records.name: TrendingBrew
records.tagline: Sip the trends. Create what’s next.
records.description: TrendingBrew uses AI to understand your YouTube channel and discover trending videos relevant to your niche. Get personalized content ideas and recommendations delivered to your inbox—so you spend less time searching and more time creating. Sip the trends. Create what’s next. ☕🚀

records.name: Complere Infosystem
records.tagline: Strategize with Data, Succeed with Insights
records.description: Complere Infosystem is a multinational technology company that serves as the trusted technology partner for our clients. We are working with some of the most advanced and independent tech companies in the world. We have expertise in Data Analytics, Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data integration, Security, and App development.

records.name: AI Baby Tales
records.tagline: Turn your child's drawings into illustrated stories
records.description: Turn your child’s drawings, pictures, and ideas into personalized bedtime stories. AI Baby Tales creates stories tailored to your child’s age and interests, ready to read together or listen to. Start with something they imagined and make it tonight’s adventure - with no ads to interrupt storytime.

records.name: Zed: A to Z — Letter Merge Puzzle
records.tagline: Sliding tile alphabet puzzle
records.description: This a brand new game build the Liquid Glass interface on iOS, its a simple game mechanic that's really addictive. It looks great, its fun to play and is accessible to people of all ages.

records.name: DynaTech Ops Ai
records.tagline: Intelligent AI Solutions for Smarter Business Growth
records.description: DynaTech is a trusted AI solutions company based in New York, helping businesses automate operations, improve productivity, and accelerate digital transformation through intelligent AI technologies. We specialize in custom AI development, AI voice agents, AI chatbots, document AI, computer vision, workflow automation, and enterprise AI solutions tailored to meet unique business requirements. Address : 1547 B Finnegan Ln, North Brunswick, NJ 08902

records.name: HappyHourTap
records.tagline: Find the best happy hour deals & drink specials near you
records.description: Discover nearby happy hours, drink specials, and food deals in real-time. The #1 free happy hour finder app for iOS and Android — save money at bars and restaurants near you.

records.name: Applyvio
records.tagline: Write job applications in 2 minutes, not 20
records.description: Applyvio helps job seekers stop rewriting the same application email and cover letter for every role. Set up a profile per job type (with your own pitch, tech stack and CV), then generate tailored emails, cover letters with PDF export, and LinkedIn messages — with AI or ready-made templates. Track every application, status and follow-up in one place, with a warning before you accidentally apply twice. Free to start.

records.name: RIRLift
records.tagline: Your lifting coach, built into your workout log
records.description: RIRLift turns your workout log into your next training decision. Track weight, reps and reps in reserve on iPhone or Apple Watch. Coach uses your logged sets to suggest your next load, plan training blocks and answer questions about your progress. Run a whole session from your wrist, explore 500+ exercises with demos, and see your weekly muscle map. Free to start, with no account required.

records.name: Pomro
records.tagline: A beautiful, distraction-free Pomodoro timer
records.description: Pomro is a beautifully minimal Pomodoro timer for people who want to focus without fighting their productivity app. Start a session in seconds, customize it to fit your rhythm, and stay in the flow with a compact interface that keeps distractions out of sight. No clutter. No feature overload. Just a calmer way to do your best work.

records.name: Cosigned
records.tagline: Discover products. Cosign the ones you believe in.
records.description: Cosigned is a product discovery and social proof platform where people discover products and Cosign the ones they support. Unlike launch platforms where rankings reset after a launch, Cosigned keeps every Cosign as permanent social proof. Builders get a public product page, authentic support from verified accounts, community Reasons, and private visit analytics. Products become publicly discoverable after the Cosigned badge is verified on their website.

records.name: authepy
records.tagline: Secure Email OTP without the auth-infrastructure burden
records.description: Adding OTP is easy. Operating it securely at scale isn't. Build it yourself, and you inherit generation, verification, abuse, rate limits, deliverability, and monitoring. Buy a broader auth or verification platform, and you may inherit pricing, limits, and infrastructure you don't need. Authepy turns the entire Email OTP layer into infrastructure with zero-trust security, abuse controls, deliverability safeguards, BYOD, and observability. Keep your users, database, and UI. Start free.

records.name: Digital planner hub
records.tagline: Notion & google sheet templates for life & business.
records.description: Shop Notion templates & Google sheet templates for students, personal life, ADHD, business, content creators, freelancer, and everyday life organization.

records.name: API Keys, without the terminal
records.tagline: Claude Code uses your keys. It never sees them.
records.description: A Mac menu bar app that stores your API keys once, in your Mac's own Keychain. Claude Code uses them through a built-in MCP server without ever seeing the value. Touch ID to reveal, every use logged, clipboard clears itself, 400+ services recognized.

records.name: Habitime — Track Your Smoking
records.tagline: Smoke less, one cigarette at a time.
records.description: Want to quit smoking, but not overnight? Habitime helps you smoke less at your own pace. Log cigarettes, set daily goals, and gradually increase the time between them. Discover what triggers your smoking and see your progress and money saved. Choose gradual reduction or a fixed daily target. A difficult day doesn’t erase your progress—keep tracking and take the next step when you’re ready.

records.name: fivepointfive
records.tagline: Acne Ingredient Checker
records.description: fivepointfive is a free acne ingredient checker. Paste any ingredient list and instantly spot pore-clogging (comedogenic) ingredients in your skincare, haircare, and makeup.

records.name: AsanaPals
records.tagline: Wellness that feels like coming home.
records.description: AsanaPals is an offline Android app where five animal companions help you move, rest, energize, restart and breathe, without scores, streaks, pressure or judgment.

records.name: YFolio AI: Smart OCR Vault
records.tagline: Next-gen OCR & AI search for your digital vault
records.description: YFolio AI is a smart document vault powered by advanced OCR and AI search. It transforms static paperwork, receipts, and contracts into an instantly searchable digital knowledge base, eliminating document clutter. Using state-of-the-art OCR, YFolio AI instantly extracts text from your files upon upload. Powered by Artificial Intelligence, it goes beyond storage with natural language search and smart summaries, letting you retrieve any data in seconds. Available for mobile and desktop.

records.name: Teressa
records.tagline: Build UI components together, live
records.description: Teressa is a place to design, publish and get feedback on UI components, and to build them together in live pair sessions. Copy the code or install it with one command.

records.name: logtempo — Track your time with two taps
records.tagline: Two Taps. Time Logged.
records.description: The fastest way to track your time. Log time against your tasks in two taps. Free iOS app, free web dashboard with Pro upgrade for client management and extended reporting including client billing summaries.

records.name: tiger.mom
records.tagline: a productivity app that actually holds you accountable
records.description: Other screen-time apps take your word for it. tiger.mom wants to see the work. When today's scrolling time runs out, your apps stay locked until you show what you got done. With the free version you get a pretty capable distraction blocker that allows you to build streaks and requires honor based declarations of work to get back into your apps. With pro, tiger.mom uses AI to compare your daily progress with your actual goals and only unlocks them once she thinks you put in the work!

records.name: DiscoverLaunches
records.tagline: It is a launch board for indie makers and SaaS founders
records.description: DiscoverLaunches is a weekly launch board for indie makers and SaaS founders. Paste your URL and AI fills in your listing. Every product gets a permanent page built to rank on Google and to be cited by ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, plus a dofollow backlink. Launch free, or upgrade once from $9.

records.name: ClueStep
records.tagline: Homework help that teaches the next step-Not just the answer
records.description: CluesStep helps students work through math, science and writing with guided clues instead of jumping straight to answers. Beyond tonight's homework, students can generate study plans, practice with printable worksheets and explore what to learn next. Parent / Teacher -managed profiles keep the experience grounded in each learner's grade and needs. Made by parents for other families to help kids use the technology they are already familiar with.

records.name: C2W Inventory
records.tagline: Inventory management made simple for growing businesses
records.description: C2W Inventory is an inventory management platform built for growing businesses that need more than spreadsheets without the complexity of a traditional ERP. Manage inventory across locations, sales and purchase orders, receiving, picking, barcode scanning, manufacturing and BOMs from one connected system. Work from the web, Windows desktop or Android, with integrations for QuickBooks, Shopify and major shipping platforms.

records.name: Aimless
records.tagline: AI ops agents that learn from the results of their own work
records.description: Describe a recurring job in plain words. Aimless runs it: scheduled tasks, dashboards built from the apps you already use, and approvals where it stops to ask. Every action is measured against the result that followed, and the next run uses what worked.

records.name: PlotStudio AI
records.tagline: Agentic data analysis for researchers
records.description: PlotStudio AI is an AI-powered, agentic data analysis workspace built for researchers and analysts. Upload a dataset and AI agents built for statistical analysis, powered by our own semantic layer, can inspect your data, plan and run analyses, write code, create visualizations, and produce publication-ready outputs. Your datasets, analyses, and context live together and evolve over time, with exportable results and support for adapting PlotStudio to niche domains and specialized workflows.

records.name: Tipza
records.tagline: Fair and transparent tip splits for teams
records.description: Tipza helps teams split tips fairly and transparently. Add the total, choose equal, hours, points or custom weights, and share the breakdown.

records.name: Peek
records.tagline: See every image instantly
records.description: A fast, minimal image viewer for macOS, Windows and Linux. Opens images instantly, navigates folders with arrow keys, and stays out of your way. Download Peek, a fast minimal image viewer for macOS, Windows and Linux. GPU-accelerated, folder navigation, zoom/pan/rotate, dark mode, auto-updates.

records.name: MenuMate
records.tagline: Digital QR menus and real-time ordering for restaurants
records.description: MenuMate is a digital QR menu and real-time ordering platform for restaurants and cafés. Restaurants create and update their menu online, generate QR codes for tables, and receive customer orders in real time without requiring customers to install an app.

records.name: Cyrus — Visual Product Builder
records.tagline: an visual editor with easy workflow
records.description: so cyrustudio is an website made for ui/ux designers who think figma is hard for them..so it is as easy to use canva and does the work of figma..also the npm install version will be avilable so that u cann intergate out enviorment in any AI model or place to edit it live.

records.name: Dravyaa
records.tagline: AI Powered ERP SaaS Application
records.description: Dravyaa is an AI-powered inventory and manufacturing ERP that unifies purchases, sales, stock, production/BOM, multi-warehouse and analytics in one platform. Built for Indian SME manufacturers, traders and distributors moving off Excel. Book a free demo.

records.name: ContractGuard
records.tagline: ContractGuard helps you understand contracts before signing.
records.description: AI contract analysis for legal documents — in Urdu & English ContractGuard uses advanced AI to analyze your contracts and legal agreements — in seconds. Upload a PDF or photo of any contract and get a clear breakdown of risky clauses, what they mean, and how to negotiate safer terms. Built specifically for Pakistan, ContractGuard understands Pakistani law including: • Contract Act 1872 • Transfer of Property Act 1882 • RERA (Real Estate) • SECP Regulations • Specific Relief Act 1877

records.name: Sakina — sleep without pills
records.tagline: CBT-i for insomnia, wrapped in Qur'an & calm — in Arabic
records.description: Sakina is the first Arabic-native insomnia app built on CBT-i — the treatment clinically recommended as first-line for chronic insomnia, ahead of sleeping pills. A structured nightly program and an adaptive sleep diary, paired with Qur'an, adhkar and guided breathing for a calm, faith-aligned wind-down. Free, no login. iPhone now, Android soon.

records.name: Xtra Hands
records.tagline: Family chores without the constant reminding.
records.description: Xtra Hands is a family chore and allowance app that takes the management out of managing chores. Create recurring chores, automatically rotate who's responsible, carry unfinished chores forward, send reminders, and reward completed work with money or stars. Use it together on a shared tablet or from individual devices. The first chore-doing member is free, with every feature included.

records.name: Dataset-Maker
records.tagline: Tear documents on purpose, with the answer key attached.
records.description: Dataset-Maker turns PDFs into non-overlapping torn fragments with exact ground truth for placement and adjacency. It also ships dm-bench, a reproducible torn-document reassembly benchmark with easy, medium and hard tiers, an evaluation harness, and a deterministic classical baseline. Built for document-reassembly research, with reproducibility and verifiable ground truth at the core.

records.name: Comic Factory
records.tagline: You have the story. We draw the comic.
records.description: Comic Factory is an online AI comic generator for people with stories, not spare drawing hours. Paste a scene, keep characters consistent, and export multi-panel pages in your browser.
